svg.title: A Three-Person Base Pod, Five People at Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-three-to-five-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: A Three-Person Base Pod, Five People at Scale; subtitle: Conservative and Base use 1 FT + 2 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 3 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT denotes a full-time seat and C denotes a contractor seat. The first three seats form the starting pod; the last two activate only in the scaled configuration. Seat count does not specify contractor hours or imply identical workloads.; caption: Separate purchasing authority, receipt evidence, and cash reconciliation. Use bank entitlements and documented dual authorization for new payees without sharing credentials.; stages: label: Owner and treasury lead; value: Base seat 1 — full-time capital and counterparty owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Set exposure limits, authorize commitments, manage issuer relationships, and maintain the repayment calendar. Review cleared ACH and reserve sufficiency daily; suspend purchasing when liquidity headroom or counterparty reliability deteriorates.; label: Procurement and fulfillment specialist; value: Base seat 2 — contractor purchase and parcel operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Verify SKU eligibility, commitment expiry, warehouse instructions, and shipping evidence. Maintain serial number records and open carrier claims promptly. Prepare purchase batches without unilateral authority to create and pay new bank beneficiaries.; label: Reconciliation and rewards specialist; value: Base seat 3 — contractor ledger and exception operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Match card charges, accepted inventory, ACH receipts, portal attribution, and reward reversals. Reconcile purchase-price adjustments and reporting forms; send unmatched transactions to the owner with amount, age, evidence, and next action.; label: Operations and counterparty manager; value: Scaled seat 4 — additional full-time operating owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Absorb increased order volume, monitor warehouse acceptance quality, and maintain vetted counterparty capacity. Keep exposure diversified across reliable Net-3 and Net-5 groups without weakening due-date cash reserves or documentation standards.; label: Automation and controls specialist; value: Scaled seat 5 — additional contractor systems operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain the deal-commit reconciler, eligible reward router, ACH ledger, and maturity alerts using permitted exports and interfaces. Test duplicate matching, stale balances, failed imports, and issuer account restrictions before expanding volume.

rect.title: label: Owner and treasury lead; value: Base seat 1 — full-time capital and counterparty owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Set exposure limits, authorize commitments, manage issuer relationships, and maintain the repayment calendar. Review cleared ACH and reserve sufficiency daily; suspend purchasing when liquidity headroom or counterparty reliability deteriorates.

Maintain serial number records and open carrier claims promptly. Prepare purchase batches without unilateral authority to create and pay new bank beneficiaries.

Reconcile purchase-price adjustments and reporting forms; send unmatched transactions to the owner with amount, age, evidence, and next action.

Test duplicate matching, stale balances, failed imports, and issuer account restrictions before expanding volume.

Assumptions: FT denotes a full-time seat and C denotes a contractor seat. The first three seats form the starting pod; the last two activate only in the scaled configuration. Seat count does not specify contractor hours or imply identical workloads.
